name: Wildcard
long_description:
Wildcard is the full-stack AEO & GEO platform for ecommerce and retail brands. We audit and action on how you show up across across AI search and AI shopping platforms like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Amazon Rufus/Alexa, and Walmart Sparky. We build the roadmap to close the gaps, and create the content that gets you recommended.

Most tools stop at a visibility score. We do the work, and are built for ecommerce brands and retailers, not SaaS. Brands using Wildcard now show up first in AI answers where they used to be invisible.

Wildcard is building the command center for agentic commerce, everything brands need to serve a new type of shopper: AI agents; including support for emerging standards like the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) and Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP).

launches.title: Wildcard: AEO, GEO, and AI Search for Ecommerce Brands
launches.tagline: Wildcard is the command center for agentic commerce. We help ecommerce and retail brands become the answer AI chooses.
launches.body:
**Traction:** 20+ Brands live. On average brands see a 5X increase in AI search revenue after 30 days.

**TL;DR:** [Wildcard ](https://wild-card.ai/)helps brands and retailers rank first across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Amazon Rufus/Alexa, and Walmart Sparky. We audit and action on how your brand, products, and collections show up across every AI search and shopping platform. Wildcard creates the roadmap, and our AI agents execute on it. We create the content AI looks for, including enriching the product catalog, new blogs, collection pages, outreach to publications, and even Reddit and YouTube content to close the gap. Operators can review, approve, and measure how actions tie back to revenue.

**Launch Video:** <https://youtu.be/dkdV-s-JztE>

**The Problem:** Shoppers are googling less and less. They want an experience where they can ask questions, like talking to an in-store rep. They're prompting about what to buy, the model names a few, people purchase those, and you're left relying on Meta's rising ad spend to acquire new customers or retain existing ones. Producing content for millions of SKUs is beyond human scale, and what we found is that millions in revenue was lost because of it. Below is what we learned after 7 months talking with brand owners.

**What We Learned:**

1. It's not about training the model. Everyone gets this wrong. When someone asks, the model runs a live search, reads what it finds, and picks. What decides it is boring and specific: a catalog structured so the model can trust it, and the right content on the sources it reads.
2. Existing tools were built for SaaS. They hand you a score and stop. That playbook breaks the moment you have 5,000 SKUs and variants. A brand and retailers unit of AEO is the catalog, not a homepage.

**The Solution:** Our solution is simple. First, we run a full audit of how you show up across AI search. Second, we build your roadmap. Lastly, we optimize your product catalog and create the content that gets you recommended. After 30 days, we tend to see a 5x increase in revenue.

**Our Ask:** Try a free trial of our tool [here](https://wild-card.ai/). And if you know any brands, retailers, or agencies, an intro would be great!: [kaushik@wild-card.ai](mailto:kaushik@wild-card.ai)  

**About Me:** Kaushik Mahorker (Founder & CEO). Previously, I was an Engineering Manager at Scale AI, where I led the GenAI Allocation team and built the ecommerce enrichment engine that structured 2.4M attributes across 400K SKUs, helping close $15M+ in retail and marketplace contracts.
